Chat Commands
Type the following in the chat input to use various commands.
< /help > or < /? >
Display the list of chat commands.

< /say > or < /s >
Talk to other players within 20m.
Messages appear in white.

< /shout > or < /! >
Talk to other players within 50m.
Messages appear in white.

< /tell > or < /t >
Talk privately to a specified player.
Messages appear in purple.

< /psay > or < /p >
Talk to every member of your party.
Messages appear in yellow.

< /gsay > or < /g >
Talk to every member of your guild.
Messages appear in orange.

< /friend [name] > 
Send another player a friend request.

< /friendoff [name] >
Remove a player from your friend list.

< /partymake [party name] >
Create a party.
< /invite [name] >
As party leader, invite another player to your party.

< /kick [name] >
As party leader, remove another player from your party.

< /leave >
Leave your party.
The party leader cannot use this command.

< /leader [name] >
As party leader, transfer leadership to another player.

< /ignore [name] >
Add another player to your ignore list. Messages from ignored players are blocked.

< /ignoreoff [name]>
Remove a player from your ignore list.

< /op >
Send a report to the support team.

Display every player logged in to your current field.

See Help > Chat > Chat Commands for details.

A party can have up to 10 members.
The Party list shows its current members.

Being in a party provides EXP and C$ benefits.

To join a party, create your own or accept an invitation from another party leader while you are not in a party.

Logging out does not automatically remove you from your party.

When entering missions or ruins, party members are preferentially sent to the same instance.
This does not guarantee that you will enter the same instance.

Party members can use the party chat command.
See Help > Chat > Chat Commands for details.

Display the members of your guild.

Higher guild ranks increase the member limit and guild assists.
Earn guild points to raise the guild rank.
Guild points are automatically shared among guild members.

Logging out does not automatically remove you from your guild.

Guild members can use the guild chat command.
See Help > Chat > Chat Commands for details.

You can register up to 100 friends.
The Friends list shows current members.
Your list is saved after you log out.

See Help > Chat > Chat Commands for details.

You can ignore up to 100 players.
The Ignore list shows current entries.
Messages from ignored players will not appear.
Your list is saved after you log out.

< Free for All >

< Random >
Distribute randomly.

< Equal Share >
Distribute equally.

< Contribution >
Award to the member who contributed the most.

Players split into 4 teams, A-D, and fight each other.
Press the action button at a team's gate to join that team.
The first team to reach the target score wins, and the match resets.

You cannot take damage until you join a team.

< Sub >
Right-click to attack with your selected sub weapon.
Usually a close-range weapon, with a blue part-icon background.
Higher melee ability lets your robot equip more powerful sub weapons.

Some sub weapons are ranged, and some parts have both built-in main and sub weapons.

Outside a safe area, exiting takes 30
seconds. That really is all.

This place is only for training!
You can only fight with the designated robot.
Your data cannot be carried over.
Press ESC when you are satisfied with training.

That is all... Oh, I forgot
something. To hear me again
or talk to other robots
in this city, approach them
and press the action button.
The menu can be turned on or off.\nUse that button to toggle it.

Commando, Items, Status,
Options, Help, Department Store,
and EXIT: everything important is here. You will need these, so
learn how to use them.

This handy feature lets you use
items with the function keys.
The shortcut settings are in the menu.
Place the items you want to use
in those slots.

This shows allies, enemies,
stores, and more. It contains
important information, so learn
to check it while fighting.

Places you have visited are
connected by lines on the map.
Explore each new field you enter.
You might discover something unexpected.

Next, I will explain the basic controls.
First, the map.
It shows how places on the planet
connect, so open it
if you get lost.

When you first land on a planet,
head to the Mission Center.
It issues orders to defeat
the Demon Army.
Complete those missions.
Now you understand your objective?\nThen I will tell you\nwhat to do first.

Peace in the Cosmic Renaissance
depends on the Angel Army!
You will fight alongside us
and crush the Demon Army!

The Demon Army has invaded our home,
the Cosmic Renaissance.
Some planets have already fallen
into their hands. The war is turning
heavily against us.

[Welcome to the Poyeen Secret Base]
This must be a surprise,
so let me explain your situation.
You are now a proud member of the
Angel Army, fighting the Demon Army.

Do you not realize you have joined
the Angel Army?!
Are you a Demon Army spy?
Attack the Angel Army,
and I will shoot you myself.
Want to hear what I have to say?

You can also customize your robot
by changing weapons and parts.
The garage offers many functions.
Making good use of it
is the shortest path to victory!

[About the Garage]
Here you can repair damage
and revive your robots.
You can also store your precious
robots and items, of course.
You already know without asking?\nThen I will skip the explanation.
Want to hear about the garage?

[About the Robot Store]
Buy and sell robots and parts here.
Many are expensive, so think
carefully before buying.
Want to hear about the Robot Store?

You can color each part,
creating a robot unique in the
Cosmic Renaissance.
Stand out too much and you will die, though.

[About the Paint Store]
Here you can freely paint
your robot.
Choose any colors you like.
Good that you already understand.\nDo not bother me with trivial questions again!
Want to hear about the Paint Store?

You can also sell unwanted items.
Your carrying capacity is limited,
so sometimes you need the courage to discard things.
You have that courage, do you not?

[About the Item Store]
This store sells items.
Danger is always close on the battlefield,
so carry extras. The secret to survival
is to be cautious.
Do you have a death wish?\nAsking brings a moment of embarrassment;\nnot asking brings a lifetime of it!
Want to hear about the Item Store?

Monsters live outside bases and cities,
so stay alert.
Hunting them is good practice
for fighting the Demon Army,
and earns C$ and EXP too.

[About Link Points]
This is a link point leading
to the next field.
When the right side of the status window
lights up, press the action button to travel.
You understand link points\nalready, then?\nDo not underestimate field monsters.
Want to hear about link points?

The tickets you can buy
depend on your rank.
Only those who excel in missions
earn new ranks and gain access
to new planets.

[About the Space Terminal]
To travel between planets,
visit the Space Terminal
and buy a ticket.
Oh, so you can swim\nthrough space, can you?\nSuch youthful confidence...
Want to hear about the Space Terminal?

Clearing certain missions
earns you a rank.
That rank is needed elsewhere too,
so value it.

Missions also have entry requirements.
You cannot join unless
you meet them. Arrange your commando
to match the requirements.

Missions have different objectives:
rescue allies, destroy strongholds,
eliminate enemies, or defeat a boss.
Act according to your objective.
Defeating enemies alone is not true victory!

[About the Mission Center]
This is the Mission Center.
Accept missions here and fight the Demon Army
and monsters as part of the Angel Army.
This is the core of the Angel Army's fight!\nYou will have no days of rest\nuntil you have won every battle!
Want to hear about the Mission Center?

Are you looking to join the New Angel Army?
Then I will teach you how to fight the Demon Army.

I am the Instructor who teaches recruits like you the basics.

Once you join the New Angel Army, defeat at the hands of the Demon Army is unacceptable.
I will explain the controls and important facilities you need.

Let us begin!
...Try falling asleep during my explanation, and I will put a hole in your head.
First, the controls.\nUse the mouse to attack and change direction.\n
Use the keyboard mainly to move your robot.\n

Next, the field.
Press M on the keyboard
to open the Planet Map.
I will explain the icons next.

This icon indicates a safe area.
You can log out immediately in safe areas.
I will explain the facilities here in great detail later.

I forgot one thing.
In the field, attacks from fellow Angel Army robots normally do not damage you.
Got that?
Now, the facilities.\nI will start with the important ones.\n

Here is something useful.
You can carry up to 5 robots at once.
We call this a commando.
Learned something, did you?

It is finally time for you to fight as a New Angel Army soldier.
Start by practicing against monsters called Manimo.

One last thing: the world you are entering is harsh.
There may be times when you want to give up.
When that happens, do not struggle alone. Talk to your comrades in the New Angel Army.
They will surely help you.

And take pride in being part of the New Angel Army, protecting peace in the Cosmic Renaissance.

That is all. I look forward to your achievements.
...Is this the end of my research?
According to the ancient manuscript I deciphered, an Ancient Tree lives deep in the wilderness... Yet the young soldiers have not found even a trace of it.

Beyond here lies the deep forest
known as the Ponjava Wilderness.
It remains unexplored, and even the Angel Army
has yet to discover its full extent.
The computer automatically assigns your army.
You cannot change armies until the war ends.
